title: Identification of osimertinib (AZD9291) as a lysine specific demethylase 1 inhibitor.
extracted_abstract: Osimertinib (AZD9291) is a third-generation epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) that has been approved for the treatment of EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). In this study, osimertinib was characterized as a LSD1 inhibitor for the first time with an IC(50) of 3.98 ± 0.3 μM and showed LSD1 inhibitory effect at cellular level. These findings provide new molecular skeleton for dual inhibitor for LSD1 and EGFR. Osimertinib could serve as a lead compound for further development for anti-NSCLC drug discovery with dual targeting.
